review_scope: Manufactured algorithm fixture stationarity and KKT certification only

validation.oracle_method: Closed-form scalar minimizers and Decimal(80-digit) posterior covariance conditioning; independent of production precision-form KKT face enumeration

review_findings: Stationarity normalization uses the sum of absolute objective and equality-multiplier operands before cancellation, separately for each normalized control coordinate.
The scalar J=0.5*x^2 + 0.5*(2*x-1)^2 case returns x=0.4 and passes its certificate.
Fault-injected incorrect interior solution and an upper face with a negative upper-bound multiplier both fail KKT certification.
A 1000x state-unit re-expression preserves the solution and reported active-lower/equality certificate.
limitations: These are manufactured linear-algorithm fixtures; they do not establish runtime behavior in Cloud-BAL or a scientific forecast result.
The SPD oracle fixtures are deterministic and well conditioned; this review did not claim broad ill-conditioned covariance coverage.
No graph extraction or KG update was performed as part of this delegated independent test task.
